panels.title: Trafik Masuk Rata-Rata per Gedung (Mbps, Window 1 Menit)

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_end AS time, building_id AS metric, avg_port_in_mbps AS value FROM streaming.window_metrics_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND avg_port_in_mbps IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Jumlah Klien WiFi per Gedung (Window 1 Menit)

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_end AS time, building_id AS metric, total_wifi_clients AS value FROM streaming.window_metrics_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND total_wifi_clients > 0 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latensi p95 per Gedung (ms, Window 5 Menit — Batas SLA 100 ms)

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_end AS time, building_id AS metric, p95_latency_ms AS value FROM streaming.window_metrics_5m WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND p95_latency_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Packet Loss Maksimum per Gedung (%, Window 5 Menit — Batas SLA 2%)

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_end AS time, building_id AS metric, max_packet_loss_pct AS value FROM streaming.window_metrics_5m WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND max_packet_loss_pct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Alert Real-Time (Pelanggaran SLA, Heartbeat > 2 Menit, Anomali Trafik)

targets.rawSql: SELECT alert_time AS waktu_wib, building_id AS gedung, device_id AS perangkat, alert_type AS jenis_alert, severity AS tingkat, round(metric_value::numeric, 2) AS nilai, message AS pesan FROM streaming.realtime_alerts ORDER BY alert_time DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Anomali Trafik (Moving Average 1 Jam +/- 3 Std)
panels.description: Anomali trafik (rata-rata bergerak 1 jam +/- 3 std) muncul setelah lonjakan trafik (mis. flash crowd) dan membutuhkan warm-up minimal 10 sampel.

targets.rawSql: SELECT detected_at AS waktu_wib, building_id AS gedung, device_id AS perangkat, round(port_in_mbps::numeric, 1) AS mbps, round(upper_band::numeric, 1) AS batas_atas, round(z_score::numeric, 2) AS z_score FROM streaming.traffic_anomalies ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 30
